item.title: Construction to resume on Hudson Tunnel Project
item.description: All $205M in frozen federal funds for the Gateway rail tunnel project have been released after lawsuits by New York and New Jersey.

item.title: Solar industry accelerates shift from silver to copper
item.description: Solar manufacturers are replacing silver with copper after a 130% silver price surge drove up photovoltaic panel costs and squeezed margins.

item.title: Tech giants building shadow power grid for AI data centers
item.description: Tech giants are building off-grid AI data centers powered by natural gas, bypassing utilities and raising climate and reliability concerns.

item.title: China seeks to reshape global trade dynamics
item.description: China is accelerating trade deals with the EU, Gulf States and CPTPP members to blunt Trump tariffs and reshape global trade dynamics.

item.title: Alliant Energy battery project in Sheboygan underway after delays
item.description: Alliant Energy’s 99-MW battery storage project in Sheboygan faces delays but could be online by year’s end, boosting clean energy capacity.

item.title: U.S. trade deficit widens as imports surge in December
item.description: U.S. trade deficit widened to $70.3B in December as imports surged. Goods gap hit record high in 2025 despite Trump tariffs.

item.title: On the Market: Shakopee and Maple Grove industrial for sale
item.description: Dean Lakes Corporate Center in Shakopee and Arbor Lakes Business Park in Maple Grove offer modern industrial space for sale or lease in fast-growing suburbs.

item.title: Construction among sectors seeing rise in union membership
item.description: Union membership rose to 10% in 2025, with 14.7 million workers represented, despite Trump administration moves targeting federal labor rights.

item.title: AI adoption reshaping Minnesota construction
item.description: AI tools like ChatGPT are helping Minnesota construction companies cut costs, boost productivity and address labor shortages, industry leaders say.

item.title: House panel rejects $50M rental aid bill
item.description: Minnesota House committee rejected a $50M emergency rental assistance bill tied to Operation Metro Surge after a party-line vote.
